nodes.label: Welcome
nodes.content:
# Welcome

A tiny demo vault for Memory Galaxy. It is here so the plugin has something to
draw before you point it at your own notes.

Start from [[Projects/Roadmap]], skim the [[Ideas]] parking lot, and check what
happened on [[Daily/2024-05-01]].
